workflows.title: MiniMax H3 image to video · Auto Prompt
workflows.description: Animate any image with MiniMax H3 while AI writes the prompt. Photo-to-video with sound for AI influencers, characters and cartoons.
notes: Replace prompt placeholders and supply your own input images, video or audio before running.
Add your OpenRouter API key to use Auto Prompt.
workflows.body:
MiniMax H3 is an open AI video model that generates video **with sound** in one pass: voices, sound effects and ambience come out already synced to the picture. Load an image and type a short idea. Gemini 3 Flash looks at your image and writes the detailed prompt for you.

**Great for:**
- Animating AI influencer photos without prompt writing
- Cartoon and character animation
- Fast image-to-video tests

### How it works
1. Add your OpenRouter API key.
2. Load your image and type a short idea.
3. Run it and get a video with audio.

### Make it yours with LoRAs
This workflow supports LoRAs. Grab character, style, anime or cartoon LoRAs from [CivitAI](https://civitai.com) or [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co), drop them into the LoRA loader, and keep your AI character looking the same in every shot.

settings.label: Steps
value: 8 with the turbo LoRA at full strength
10-12 with the turbo LoRA at lower strength for better quality

workflows.title: MiniMax H3 RefMod
workflows.description: Skip LoRA training: load saved RefMods of your character, video or voice into MiniMax H3 and make consistent AI video with sound.
notes: Replace prompt placeholders and supply your own input images, video or audio before running.
workflows.body:
A RefMod replaces LoRA training for MiniMax H3. Instead of training a LoRA, you save a reusable reference of a character, a video or a sound in a few minutes, then load it whenever you generate.

The RefMod pack has four workflows: three that **create** RefMods (from images, video or audio) and the main [MiniMax H3 RefMod](/comfyui-workflows/minimax-h3-refmod/) workflow that **uses** them. For example, feed 24 photos of your AI influencer into the image workflow, save a RefMod, and load it here to generate videos of that exact character.

**Great for:**
- Consistent AI influencers without training a LoRA
- Recurring cartoon and anime characters
- Reusing a motion or a sound across many videos

### How it works
1. Create RefMods with the [image](/comfyui-workflows/minimax-h3-refmod-image-pack/), [video](/comfyui-workflows/minimax-h3-refmod-video-pack/) or [audio](/comfyui-workflows/minimax-h3-refmod-audio-pack/) workflows.
2. Load up to eight RefMods here.
3. Write your scene and run it to get a video with audio.

### Make it yours with LoRAs
This workflow supports LoRAs. Grab character, style, anime or cartoon LoRAs from [CivitAI](https://civitai.com) or [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co), drop them into the LoRA loader, and keep your AI character looking the same in every shot.
